title_en: Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (IV)

articles.content_en: Article 1: Where the subject matter of insurance has been delivered to the transferee, but the ownership change registration has not yet been completed according to law, and the transferee bearing the risk of damage or loss of the subject matter of insurance claims to exercise the rights of the insured in accordance with Articles 48 and 49 of the Insurance Law, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 2: Where the insurer has performed the duty of presentation and explicit explanation as prescribed by the Insurance Law to the policy holder, and the transferee of the subject matter of insurance claims that the clauses exempting the insurer from liability do not become contract content on the ground that the insurer failed to make presentation or explicit explanation to it after the transfer of the subject matter of insurance, the People's Court shall not support the claim.
Article 3: Where the insured dies, and a party who inherits the subject matter of insurance claims to succeed to the rights and obligations of the insured, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 5: Where, after the insured or the transferee timely sends a notice of transfer of the subject matter of insurance to the insurer according to law, and before the insurer makes a reply, an insured event occurs, and the insured or the transferee claims that the insurer shall bear the liability to pay insurance money in accordance with the insurance contract, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 6: After the occurrence of an insured event, where the insured, in accordance with Article 57 of the Insurance Law, requests the insurer to bear the necessary and reasonable expenses paid for preventing or reducing the loss of the subject matter of insurance, and the insurer defends on the ground that the measures taken by the insured have not produced actual effect, the People's Court shall not support the defense.

Article 7: Where the insurer, in accordance with Article 60 of the Insurance Law, claims to exercise by subrogation the right of the insured to claim compensation due to the third party's tort or breach of contract, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 8: Where the policy holder and the insured are different subjects, and an insured event is caused by the policy holder's damage to the subject matter of insurance, if the insurer claims according to law to exercise by subrogation the right of the insured to claim compensation against the policy holder, the People's Court shall support the claim, unless otherwise provided by law or otherwise agreed in the insurance contract.

Article 9: In an action of subrogation right initiated by the insurer with the third party as the defendant, where the third party defends on the ground that the insured had waived its right to claim compensation against it before the conclusion of the insurance contract, and the People's Court determines that the aforesaid waiver is lawful and valid, if the insurer claims to exercise the subrogation right in respect of the corresponding part, the People's Court shall not support the claim.
Where, at the time of conclusion of the insurance contract, the insurer made an inquiry as to whether the aforesaid waiver existed, and the policy holder failed to truthfully disclose the information, resulting in the insurer's inability to exercise by subrogation the right to claim compensation, the People's Court shall support the insurer's request for return of the corresponding insurance money, unless the insurer knew or should have known of the aforesaid circumstances and nevertheless agreed to underwrite the insurance.

Article 10: Where an insured event is caused by a third party's damage to the subject matter of insurance, and before the situation that the insurer has obtained the right to claim compensation by subrogation is notified to the third party or before the notice reaches the third party, the third party makes compensation to the insured within the scope for which the insured has already obtained compensation from the insurer, if the insurer claims to exercise by subrogation the right of the insured to claim compensation against the third party, the People's Court shall not support the claim. If the insurer claims that the insured shall return the corresponding insurance money, the People's Court shall support the claim.
Where the situation that the insurer has obtained the right to claim compensation by subrogation has been notified to the third party, and the third party makes compensation to the insured again, if the insurer claims to exercise the right to claim compensation by subrogation, and the third party defends on the ground that it has already compensated the insured, the People's Court shall not support the defense.

Article 11: Where the insured, due to intentional conduct or gross negligence, fails to perform the obligations prescribed by Article 63 of the Insurance Law, resulting in the insurer's failure to exercise or fully exercise the right to claim compensation by subrogation, and the insurer claims to deduct or obtain the return of the corresponding insurance money within the scope of its loss, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 12: Where the insurer initiates an action of subrogation right with the third party who caused the insured event as the defendant, the competent court shall be determined based on the legal relationship between the insured and the third party.

Article 13: Where, at the time the insurer initiates an action of subrogation right, the insured has already filed a lawsuit against the third party, the People's Court may, according to law, consolidate the trials.
Where, when the insurer exercises the subrogation right, the insured has already filed a lawsuit against the third party, and the insurer applies to the People's Court accepting the case to change the party and to exercise by subrogation the right of the insured to claim compensation against the third party, if the insured consents, the People's Court shall permit it; if the insured does not consent, the insurer may participate in the lawsuit as a co-plaintiff.

Article 15: Where, after the compensation liability that the insured should bear to the third party has been determined, the insured fails to perform the compensation liability, and when the third party files a lawsuit with the insurer as the defendant or with the insurer and the insured as co-defendants, if the insured has not yet made a request to the insurer to directly pay insurance money to the third party, it may be determined as a circumstance of "the insured's failure to diligently request" as prescribed in Article 65, Paragraph 2 of the Insurance Law.

Article 16: Where the insured under liability insurance bears joint and several liability according to law due to joint tort, and the insurer refuses to pay insurance money on the ground that the joint and several liability exceeds the share of liability that the insured should bear, the People's Court shall not support the refusal. Where, after bearing the insurance liability, the insurer claims to seek recourse against other joint and several liable persons for the part exceeding the insured's share of liability, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 17: Where the compensation liability borne by the insured under liability insurance to a third party has been confirmed by an effective judgment and has entered the enforcement procedure, but has not been satisfied or not fully satisfied, and the third party requests the insurer to pay insurance money according to law, if the insurer defends on the ground that the aforesaid effective judgment has entered the enforcement procedure, the People's Court shall not support the defense.

Article 18: The limitation of action period for the insured under commercial liability insurance to request the insurer to pay insurance money shall be calculated from the date on which the compensation liability that the insured should bear to the third party is determined.

Article 19: Where the insured under liability insurance and the third party reach a settlement agreement regarding the insured's compensation liability, and the insurer approves it, if the insured claims that the insurer shall bear insurance liability within the scope of the insurance contract pursuant to the settlement agreement, the People's Court shall support the claim.
Where the insured and the third party reach a settlement agreement regarding the insured's compensation liability without the insurer's approval, if the insurer claims to re-determine the scope of insurance liability and the amount of compensation, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 20: Where the insurer under liability insurance pays insurance money to the insured before the insured compensates the third party, and when the third party exercises the right to claim insurance money in accordance with Article 65, Paragraph 2 of the Insurance Law, if the insurer refuses to pay insurance money on the ground that it has already paid compensation to the insured, the People's Court shall not support the refusal. If the insurer, after paying compensation to the third party, requests the insured to return the corresponding insurance money, the People's Court shall support the claim.

Article 21: This Interpretation shall come into force as of September 1, 2018.
After this Interpretation comes into force, this Interpretation shall apply to cases of first instance and second instance that are being tried by the People's Court; for cases that have been finally adjudicated before this Interpretation comes into force, and for which a party applies for retrial or a retrial is decided in accordance with the trial supervision procedure, this Interpretation shall not apply.
